provides.label: Preservation-first repository and dataset synchronization
provides.description: Explicit encrypted backups, verified layer snapshots and additive peer exchange; not unattended fleet synchronization.

dependencies.reason: The opt-in Frog layer invokes the external frog snapshot CLI to export AGENTS.db. Frog owns the live database; Rebsync validates and stores the exported snapshot.
The opt-in Mneme layer invokes the external mneme snapshot create, verify and restore commands using the mneme.snapshot.v1 contract.
